node.title: Re^3: Error: Can't locate Test/Exception.pm in @INC ...
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
testing croak without the use of any secondary test module

I realized the other day that since all I was using from [mod://Test::Fatal] was its exception function, I could successfully replace it with the following, with no changes to my tests necessary. However, this still theoretically suffers from the same [id://1153468|problems] I linked to earlier.

sub exception (&) { return eval { shift->(); 1 } ? undef : ($@ || confess "\$@ was false"); }
